records.title: SC*: universal fixed-source coefficient stopping
records.promotion_gate: Independent review of PR #84 and merge to main.
records.record_specific_promotion_review: Confirm the obligation is universal finite coefficient stopping, not the stronger literature equality conjecture.
records.statement: Prove that every positive integer has finite coefficient stopping time, equivalently that the least source m_N^sup of an all-supercritical depth-N cylinder tends to infinity.
records.scope: One fixed ordinary source; not moving finite witnesses or a 2-adic completion.
exclusions: No reviewed PR proves this obligation.

records.title: FC*: complete first-crossing and full-denominator exclusion
records.promotion_gate: Independent review of PR #84 and merge to main.
records.record_specific_promotion_review: Confirm that the obligation includes every complete first-crossing word, d=0 cycles, d>0 near-returns, one common displacement and every complete denominator factor.
records.statement: Exclude every complete first-crossing canonical realization, including d=0 nontrivial positive cycles and d>0 acyclic near-returns, by closing the entire denominator 2^j-3^q with compatible source, endpoint, displacement and exact physical replay.
records.scope: All first-crossing words and every prime-power factor of the complete denominator.
exclusions: Proper-factor hits, bounded support, finite-length censuses or independently chosen local residues do not prove FC*.
No reviewed PR proves this obligation.

review.verdict: open; reviewed reductions and subclasses only

evidence.artifact: bounded computations inspected but not used as all-length evidence

records.title: Proposed least-counterexample bridge from SC* and FC* to Collatz
records.promotion_gate: Independent review of PR #84 and merge to main.
records.record_specific_promotion_review: REQUIRED: independently review the normalization crosswalk and exact Lane A/Lane B implication before calling the roadmap exhaustive.
records.statement: Under the shortcut-map least-positive-counterexample framework, prove that a counterexample with no coefficient crossing contradicts SC*, while a counterexample with a first crossing yields a complete nontrivial canonical FC* realization with nonnegative displacement. Rotate every nontrivial positive cycle to its minimum to place it in the same first-crossing lane. With the trivial 1↔2 cycle explicitly allowed, SC* and FC* would then imply that every positive integer reaches 1.
records.scope: A conditional repository-level reduction connecting the reviewed fixed-source coefficient language to the reviewed canonical first-crossing/full-denominator language.
exclusions: The combined crosswalk has not yet been independently reviewed as one theorem.
Until review, the architecture is a proposed roadmap bridge, not an established exhaustive reduction.

sources.role: reviewed cycle absorption and primitive reduction

review.verdict: component reductions reviewed; synthesized bridge not independently reviewed

records.repair_or_supersession: This record softens earlier strategic language: the bridge is proposed until the exact repository-level crosswalk is independently reviewed.
